title: Fishing in life and death: Pleistocene fish-hooks from a burial context on Alor Island, Indonesia

passages.quote: Another shell hook from Jerimalai Shelter in Timor-Leste is of a comparable age to the Okinawa find, in a deposit context dated to between c. 23000 and 16000 cal BP

passages.locator: Section 'AMS dating of the Tron Bon Lei burial context and grave goods'; the article's title and abstract place the burial at Tron Bon Lei on Alor Island
passages.quote: An AMS radiocarbon date of 11310–11075 cal BP (S-ANU-41825: 10230±30 BP) on hook C is consistent with a date on a fragment of charcoal from within the left eye socket of the individual of 12035–11500 cal BP

file.method: Passages of about 500 characters either side of each cited quotation, cut from the fetched page text.
